# MoDevz and MoConsultantz

MoDevz provides technical consulting, custom software, workflow automation, cybersecurity guidance, and digital strategy for small and growing businesses.

MoConsultantz provides business and technology strategy with hands-on implementation support. Engagements are led by Joshua Xavier and are available remotely across Canada and the United States.

- https://modevz.ca/technical-consulting — Technical consulting services, common use cases, and booking.
- https://modevz.ca/plans — Fixed-scope technical consulting plans.

- https://modevz.ca/plans/growth-systems — 10,000 MoCoin Growth Systems Build.

## Internal API

Use the internal API for live MoCoin Strategic Reserve market data instead of scraping third-party price pages.

- Endpoint: POST https://modevz.ca/api/market-data
- Request body: {"symbols":["ENB","AMAT","PINS","SNAP","QS","OPEN","WEED.TO","BTC","SOL","ADA","FIL"],"baseCurrency":"CAD"}
- baseCurrency can be "CAD" or "USD".
- Response fields include price, baseCurrency, nativeCurrency, sourceSymbol, usdCadRate, change1h, change4h, change1d, change7d, and change1m.

Use the internal booking API for MoConsultantz booking requests when collecting booking details directly.

- Endpoint: POST https://modevz.ca/api/booking
- Request body: {"name":"Full Name","email":"client@example.com","phone":"optional phone","date":"YYYY-MM-DD","time":"HH:mm","service":"Technical Consulting"}
- Required fields are name, email, date, time, and service. Successful requests return {"success":true} and send booking emails with a calendar attachment.
